title: x402 turns HTTP 402 into an open, crypto-native payment standard for the web
content:
x402 is an open, Apache-2.0 licensed payment standard that enables web services to charge for API access and content directly via HTTP. It activates the long-dormant `402 Payment Required` HTTP status code and uses crypto rails for speed, privacy, and efficiency.

**Why it matters:** payments become a transparent protocol layer rather than a proprietary platform — the docs deliberately position x402 as "credibly neutral," with no branded lock-in. Any server can demand payment; any client (human- or agent-driven) can pay, with no account signup.

**Evidence:** the standard defines the 402 challenge/response flow, facilitator services for verification/settlement, and batch-settlement schemes for micropayments.

Source: x402 docs introduction (https://docs.x402.org/introduction).
description: Apache-2.0 licensed standard activating the dormant 402 Payment Required status code so services charge for APIs and content directly over HTTP.
